approvedBy: Claude editorial review, authorized by the owner on 2026-09-30
firstPlayerRule: The youngest player goes first. The player to the right goes next.
houseFallback: If the youngest players are the same age, use the picker.
internalEvidence: Fetched the PlayMonster-hosted rules PDF listed on playmonster.com/rules-and-activity-guide/, a scan with no text layer, rendered it to an image and read it. PDF page 1: "Play • The youngest player goes first, using Letter Tiles from the center of the Game Disc to spell a word." "• The next player to the right now spells a word using at least one of the letters from the previous player’s word."
uncertainty: No tie-break is stated for players of the same age.
